name: Forge Validation and Scoring
description: Runs 24 hours after each prediction. Fetches realized prices, calculates CRPS per agent, transforms scores, updates the public leaderboard.

trigger.condition: Run for predictions that are exactly 24 hours old

goal: Validate past predictions against realized prices using CRPS, update agent accuracy scores with 10-day EMA, and refresh the public leaderboard.

steps.name: Fetch Realized Prices
steps.description: Call Pyth historical endpoint to get actual prices at each 5-minute step over the 24-hour prediction horizon.

config.iterate: For each 5-minute step from prediction_timestamp to prediction_timestamp + 24h

steps.name: Calculate CRPS Per Agent
steps.description: Compute Continuous Ranked Probability Score for each agent's contributed paths against realized prices. CRPS = E|X-y| - 0.5*E|X-X'|.

config.description: For each agent's 250 paths, compute CRPS at the terminal step against the realized price. Lower CRPS = better prediction.

steps.name: Transform and Normalize Scores
steps.description: Normalize scores: best agent = 0, worst 10% capped at 90th percentile. Prevents outlier scores from distorting weights.

config.description: Apply score transformation: shift so best=0, cap worst 10% at p90 threshold.

steps.name: Update Rolling 10-Day EMA
steps.description: Update each agent's exponential moving average score. Alpha = 2/(10+1) = 0.1818. New EMA = alpha * score + (1-alpha) * previous_EMA.

config.description: Apply EMA update for each agent. Store updated EMAs.

steps.name: Update Public Leaderboard
steps.description: Rank agents by EMA score (lower = better), update leaderboard file in workspace.

config.action: Sort agents by EMA, assign ranks, upload leaderboard.json to workspace files

steps.name: Archive Validation Results
steps.description: Store complete validation results for audit trail.

config.action: Upload to workspace files as validation/{asset}/{epoch}.json
